summary: The roadmap (Phase 3) asks for axe checks on every page, but REQ-170 only covers the sign-in and checkout pages. The order confirmation page and the 404 page have no accessibility requirement, so no test can be tagged for them. Please extend REQ-170 (or add a new requirement) to cover all pages; the tests are a one-line addition each once a requirement exists. Sign-in and checkout are now also scanned with their error alerts visible.
